# adana-dsa — full skill catalog

Generated from each `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` frontmatter (`area` / `use_for` / `deps`). The machine-readable version is `skills-manifest.json`; the compact domain map lives in `agents/adana.md`.

| Skill | Area | Use For | Deps |
|---|---|---|---|
| `costar-saved-search` | Collection | Process a CoStar export the user has placed in the project folder: screen it (FAR/PLSF/PSFB via gateway), persist deduped properties + contacts, and write back the qualification (score + why + buy-box checklist). | Gateway: adana_screen_costar, adana_ingest_costar_export, adana_save_qualification · Files: exports/CostarExport*.xlsx (read) · Env: gateway_api_key, ADANA_EXPORT_DIR |
| `reonomy-saved-search` | Collection | Process a Reonomy export the user has placed in the project folder: persist deduped off-market properties + owner contact shells (flow2), and write back a judgment-led qualification. | Gateway: adana_ingest_reonomy, adana_save_qualification · Files: exports/*.csv (read), exports/.processed.json (read+write) · Env: gateway_api_key, ADANA_EXPORT_DIR |
| `apollo-email-lookup` | Enrichment | Find work emails for contacts missing one, via the Apollo API (no browser): pull the gateway work list, verify each person by search before enriching, bulk-enrich by exact ID, and write the verified emails back. | MCP: apollo (Apollo.io connector) · Gateway: adana_targets_needing_enrichment, adana_save_contact_lookups · Files: apollo/results_<date>.json (write) · Env: gateway_api_key, APOLLO_DIR |
| `lexisnexis-contact-lookup` | Enrichment | Emit a work-list sheet of contacts missing an email, then read the user's completed LexisNexis results back from the project folder and write the emails/phones through the gateway. | Gateway: adana_targets_needing_enrichment, adana_save_contact_lookups · Files: lexisnexis/worklist_<date>.csv (write), lexisnexis/results_<date>.csv (read) · Env: gateway_api_key, LEXISNEXIS_DIR |
| `adana-setup` | Setup | Run once to wire up the Adana plugin in a new workspace: gateway API key, connector registration (gateway + Apollo), working folders, browser download location, and CLAUDE.md creation. | — |
| `plugin-update` | Setup | Run after a git pull to detect and fill any gaps: missing env vars, unregistered connectors, export folders + browser download location, stale CLAUDE.md embed, new skill requirements. | — |
